newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Kuwaiti fund lends Morocco $33mln for road project.
newsitem.headline: Kuwaiti fund lends Morocco $33mln for road project.

text.p: A Kuwaiti fund on Monday granted Morocco a $33 million loan to finance the building of a 30-kilometre (18-mile) motorway linking the country's financial centre of Casablanca to Settat city, the finance ministry said.

"The Kuwaiti Fund for Arab Economic Development signed an agreement with the finance ministry under which it granted Morocco a $33 million loan to help build a motorway linking Casablanca to the neighbouring Settat town," it said in a statement.
The loan was granted for 20 years with a four-year grace period with an average of four percent interest rate per year, the ministry said.
The road, which is expected to cost $119.2 million, will be operational by end 1999, it added.
Morocco has nearly 200 km (125 miles) of motorway linking Casablanca to the northern city of Larache via Rabat, officials said.
